HOW IT WORKS: Admin enters admin key to access full system. Session stored in database for security.
FAE enters unique FAE code to access their assigned tasks and appointments only.
Sessions stored in database for persistence across page reloads. User stays logged in until logout.
System restricts access based on role: Admin has full access, FAE has limited access to own data.
User can end session and return to login page. Session data is destroyed.
Admin can share direct links with FAE codes for quick login without entering code manually.
Admin can add new FAE users with name, email, department, phone, and unique FAE code.
Admin can update FAE information including name, email, department, phone, and assigned department.
Admin can remove FAE users from system. Associated tasks and data handled appropriately.
FAE can upload a profile photo when first accessing the system or from profile page.
FAE can update their profile photo anytime. System stores image filename for display.
Admin can view overall statistics for each FAE: total tasks, completed, in progress, pending, overdue.
Admin can view all FAEs in a list with their contact info, department, and task statistics.
Admin can create new tasks with name, description, deadline, priority, region, course, and FAE assignment.
Admin can modify task details including name, description, deadline, priority, and assigned FAE.
Admin can remove tasks from system. Task history/updates may be retained for audit trail.
Tasks have status: Pending, In Progress, Completed, Overdue. Admin can manually change status.
Tasks can be marked as High, Medium, or Low priority to help FAE prioritize work.
Admin can set task progress 0-100%. FAE can update progress when posting updates.
Admin can assign tasks to specific FAEs. Each task belongs to one FAE.
FAE can see only their assigned tasks. Shows task name, deadline, status, progress, and update count.
Admin can see all tasks across all FAEs with filtering and sorting options.
Task lists show: task name, assigned FAE, deadline, status, progress %, update count.
Tasks displayed in order by deadline so FAE/Admin can prioritize upcoming work.
Admin can filter tasks by status: Pending, In Progress, Completed, Overdue.
System highlights tasks past deadline. Admin sees overdue count and list on dashboard.
FAE can post progress comments/messages to update task status. Includes message, time, and optional file.
FAE can attach files (documents, images, etc.) to task updates to share work/evidence with admin.
All task updates stored with timestamp, author name, author role (admin/fae), and progress % at time of update.
System records what the task progress % was at the time each update was posted for historical tracking.
System records what the task status was at the time each update was posted for audit trail.
Task updates displayed newest first so FAE/Admin see latest progress immediately.
FAE can request an appointment with date, reason, and user name. Goes into pending status.
Admin can review pending appointments and approve, reject, or add comments with decision.
Admin can add notes/instructions to appointments (e.g., meeting location, preparation notes).
Appointments have status: Pending, Approved, Rejected. Shows FAE and Admin the current status.
Admin can see all appointments across all FAEs. FAE sees only their own appointments.
Appointments displayed on calendar view. Admin can see who has appointments on each date.
Dashboard shows next 7 days of appointments to help plan schedule.
Admin can create system-wide events like holidays, meetings, training days, deadlines.
Admin can modify event details: title, date, description, category.
Admin can remove events from calendar.
Events can be categorized (e.g., Holiday, Training, Deadline, Maintenance) for organization.
Events visible on calendar for all users. FAE and Admin both see admin events.
Admin landing page shows: total FAEs, total tasks, tasks by status, overdue count, upcoming deadlines, upcoming appointments.
FAE landing page shows: my tasks, task progress, next appointment, upcoming deadlines specific to them.
Dashboard displays key metrics: total tasks, completed, in progress, pending, overdue.
Next 7 days of task deadlines displayed in list or timeline format.
Tasks past deadline highlighted with alert badge and count displayed prominently.
Dashboard may show FAE performance: average progress %, completion rate, task velocity.
System logs all changes to tasks, FAEs, appointments for compliance and troubleshooting.
Complete history of each task including creation, edits, updates, status changes, and completion date.
Detailed view of all updates posted to a task with authors, timestamps, and progress snapshots.
Simple login form where admin/FAE enters credentials and system authenticates.
Menu system to navigate between: Dashboard, Tasks, FAEs, Appointments, Calendar, Admin Events, Logout.
System works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers with adapted layouts.
Server-side template rendering for dynamic content generation from database.
Fast asset compilation for CSS and JavaScript. Supports modern front-end tooling.
Admin can create, edit, delete departments/regions to organize FAEs.
FAEs can be assigned to departments. Tasks can be tagged by department/region.
Admin can see department list with member count and see which FAEs belong to each.
When viewing a department, can see expandable list of all FAEs in that department with contact info.
Calendar displays current month with all events, appointments, and deadlines marked on dates.
Previous/Next buttons to browse through months and see upcoming schedules.
Admin events and FAE appointments shown on calendar with different visual styles.
Default database for storing all system data. Can be switched to MySQL if needed.
Version-controlled database schema. Migrations track all table changes.
Modern PHP framework providing security, validation, routing, and ORM features.
Custom session-based auth system tailored to monitoring workflow (not standard Laravel Auth).
